title: batatas maritima
intro: Batatas maritima, commonly known as sea beet, is a type of leafy green plant that belongs to the beet family (Chenopodiaceae). It is rich in nutrients and offers various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Batatas maritima include its ability to support digestive health, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-aging effects due to its high content of vitamins A and C, potassium, and fiber. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and betalains, which contribute to its potential therapeutic and nutritional benefits.
